planned.scene: Existing painting: the youngest pig carefully lays bricks one at a time while his two older brothers laugh at his slow work.
After the straw and wooden houses are destroyed, all three pigs reach the sturdy brick house safely while the wolf remains outside at a distance; no contact, injury or violence.
Inside the brick house, the youngest pig tends a large pot as steam rises; outside, the startled wolf turns away from the chimney and bounds safely toward the forest, with no contact or injury.
